title: chaenactis glabriuscula var. aurea
intro: Chaenactis glabriuscula var. aurea, commonly known as Golden Rayless Daisy, is a flowering plant species native to the western coast of North America. This plant is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Chaenactis glabriuscula var. aurea are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
